item.claim: An optical measurement can be structured immediately into a feasibility study to track unspecified biomass and metabolic signals.
item.enquiry_quote: We would like an optical measurement during yeast fermentation to help us follow growth and notice changes earlier. Our team has mentioned both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal, but these have not been defined as separate targets. ... We need help turning this request into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.
